objective: Explain large-quantity error using stored Train/Validation evidence while authorized Cap external27 training continues unchanged.

scope.official_reference_data: Train-Q3-capped inputs and quantities (historical directory name Cap)
scope.uncapped_coverage: MLP4seed42 fullValidation and MLP16seeds42/52/62 where stored; MLP4/AllAvailableseed42 weighted stratified Train/Validation samples labelled separately

questions: Is the official ceiling group actually harder than the below-ceiling group for each model and seed?
How concentrated is pre-ceiling error in Train-defined upper tails, and does signed error agree across datasets?
Do high target quantities follow high observed quantities or abrupt jumps?
Does a deterministic previous-observation reference expose information the learned model is not using effectively?
Which training objective and inverse transform are actually executed, and how do they relate to quantity RMSE/MAE?
analysis_rules: Verify stored input hashes and exact target population; preserve all seed exceptions.
Keep target-conditioned retrospective diagnosis distinct from observable-context conditioning and causal explanations.
No comparison of raw RMSE differences between different capped and uncapped targets.
No pooled raw metric across datasets; sample SD ddof1; weighted Train sample is not a full Train evaluation.
Conditional transition variability from last quantity alone does not prove irreducible unpredictability.
A log-loss mathematical mismatch does not establish that log1p input is the sole or principal empirical cause.
Do not interpret parameter count, tail sparsity, errors, or correlations as causal proof or statistical significance.
